questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'I' đi với 'was'.

exercise_groups.group_title: 3. Dạng Khẳng Định (+) S + was/were + V-ing
exercise_groups.instruction: Chia động từ ở thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn dạng khẳng định:

questions.prompt: The children (be, play) [blank] in the park.
questions.explanation: The children là số nhiều ➔ were playing.

questions.prompt: He (be, cook) [blank] dinner when I arrived.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ He là số ít ➔ was cooking.

questions.prompt: We (be, watch) [blank] a movie last night.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ We là số nhiều ➔ were watching.

questions.prompt: The sun (be, shine) [blank] brightly all day.
questions.explanation: The sun là số ít; shine bỏ -e thêm -ing ➔ was shining.

questions.prompt: They (be, discuss) [blank] the project in the meeting.
questions.explanation: They là số nhiều ➔ were discussing.

questions.prompt: She (be, draw) [blank] a picture while he was writing a story.
questions.explanation: She là số ít ➔ was drawing.

questions.prompt: The train (be, arrive) [blank] at the station when I got there.
questions.explanation: The train là số ít; arrive bỏ -e thêm -ing ➔ was arriving.

questions.prompt: I (be, listen) [blank] to music while studying.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ I đi với was ➔ was listening.

questions.prompt: The cat (be, sleep) [blank] on the couch.
questions.explanation: The cat là số ít ➔ was sleeping.

questions.prompt: We (be, enjoy) [blank] our vacation last summer.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ We đi với were ➔ were enjoying.

exercise_groups.group_title: 4. Dạng Phủ Định (–) S + was/were + NOT + V-ing
exercise_groups.instruction: Chia động từ ở dạng phủ định của thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn:

questions.prompt: The children (be, not, play) [blank] video games at 12 o’clock last night.
questions.explanation: The children là số nhiều ➔ were not playing / weren't playing.

questions.prompt: He (be, not, cook) [blank] dinner yesterday when I called.
questions.explanation: He là số ít ➔ was not cooking / wasn't cooking.

questions.prompt: We (be, not, watch) [blank] the news at this time last weekend.
questions.explanation: We là số nhiều ➔ were not watching / weren't watching.

questions.prompt: The sun (be, not, shine) [blank] during the storm at 7 o’clock this morning.
questions.explanation: The sun là số ít ➔ was not shining / wasn't shining.

questions.prompt: They (be, not, discuss) [blank] anything important when I entered.
questions.explanation: They là số nhiều ➔ were not discussing / weren't discussing.

questions.prompt: She (be, not, draw) [blank] in her notebook while I was studying.
questions.explanation: She là số ít ➔ was not drawing / wasn't drawing.

questions.prompt: The train (be, not, arrive) [blank] on time at 4 o’clock yesterday.
questions.explanation: The train là số ít ➔ was not arriving / wasn't arriving.

questions.prompt: I (be, not, listen) [blank] to the radio while studying at this time last night.
questions.explanation: I đi với was ➔ was not listening / wasn't listening.

questions.prompt: The cat (be, not, sleep) [blank] on the bed when I walked in.
questions.explanation: The cat là số ít ➔ was not sleeping / wasn't sleeping.

questions.prompt: We (be, not, enjoy) [blank] the concert at this time last month.
questions.explanation: We là số nhiều ➔ were not enjoying / weren't enjoying.

exercise_groups.group_title: 5. Dạng Câu Hỏi (?) Was / Were + S + V-ing?
exercise_groups.instruction: Điền từ đúng để hoàn thành câu hỏi ở quá khứ tiếp diễn / to be:

questions.prompt: [blank] this your favorite book at 12 o’clock last night?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'this' số ít ➔ Was.

questions.prompt: The milk smelled fresh. It [blank] (be, not, expire) when I checked.
questions.explanation: Hành động tại thời điểm kiểm tra trong quá khứ ➔ wasn't expiring.

questions.prompt: [blank] they coming to the party at this time last week?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'they' số nhiều ➔ Were.

questions.prompt: [blank] I in the right room when the meeting started?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'I' ➔ Was.

questions.prompt: The train was running on time today. It [blank] (be, not, be) late.
questions.explanation: Động từ To Be trong quá khứ ➔ was not / wasn't.

questions.prompt: [blank] you going to the market at this time yesterday?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'you' ➔ Were.

questions.prompt: [blank] we allowed to use our phones in class last week?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'we' ➔ Were.

questions.prompt: [blank] she your sister at this time last year?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'she' ➔ Was.

questions.prompt: [blank] it going to rain this afternoon when I left?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'it' ➔ Was.

questions.prompt: The flowers [blank] (bloom) beautifully at this time last year.
questions.explanation: The flowers số nhiều ➔ were blooming.

questions.prompt: [blank] he your best friend at that time?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'he' ➔ Was.

questions.prompt: The students [blank] (read) in the library when the bell rang.
questions.explanation: The students số nhiều ➔ were reading.

questions.prompt: [blank] I late for the meeting last week?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'I' ➔ Was.

exercise_groups.group_title: 6. Bài 1: Viết Dạng -ing Của 15 Động Từ
exercise_groups.instruction: Áp dụng đúng các quy tắc để viết dạng đuôi -ing:

questions.prompt: take ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Tận cùng là 'e' ➔ bỏ 'e' thêm -ing: taking.

questions.prompt: drive ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Tận cùng là 'e' ➔ bỏ 'e' thêm -ing: driving.

questions.prompt: see ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Đuôi 'ee' giữ nguyên thêm -ing: seeing.

questions.prompt: agree ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Đuôi 'ee' giữ nguyên thêm -ing: agreeing.

questions.prompt: open ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Trọng âm âm tiết 1 ➔ không gấp đôi phụ âm: opening.

questions.prompt: enter ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Trọng âm rơi vào âm 1 ➔ không gấp đôi: entering.

questions.prompt: happen ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Trọng âm rơi vào âm 1 ➔ không gấp đôi: happening.

questions.prompt: try ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Tận cùng là 'y' giữ nguyên thêm -ing: trying.

questions.prompt: play ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Tận cùng là 'y' giữ nguyên thêm -ing: playing.

questions.prompt: work ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Động từ bình thường thêm -ing: working.

questions.prompt: speak ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Có 2 nguyên âm 'ea' ➔ không gấp đôi: speaking.

questions.prompt: get ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: 1 nguyên âm kẹp giữa 2 phụ âm ➔ gấp đôi 't': getting.

questions.prompt: travel ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Chấp nhận cả traveling (Mỹ) và travelling (Anh).

questions.prompt: lie ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: Tận cùng là '-ie' ➔ đổi thành '-y' rồi thêm -ing: lying.

questions.prompt: win ➔ [blank]
questions.explanation: 1 nguyên âm kẹp giữa 2 phụ âm ➔ gấp đôi 'n': winning.

exercise_groups.group_title: 7. Viết Lại Câu: Chuyển Sang Câu Hỏi & Câu Phủ Định (+ ➔ ? / -)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chuyển câu khẳng định sau sang câu hỏi và phủ định tương ứng:

questions.prompt: She was reading a book. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
questions.explanation: Đưa 'Was' lên trước chủ ngữ 'she'.

questions.prompt: She was reading a book. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau 'was': was not / wasn't reading a book.

questions.prompt: They were playing soccer in the park. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: they playing soccer in the park?
they playing soccer in the park
questions.explanation: Đưa 'Were' lên trước chủ ngữ 'they'.

questions.prompt: They were playing soccer in the park. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: were not playing soccer in the park.
were not playing soccer in the park
weren't playing soccer in the park.
weren't playing soccer in the park
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau 'were': were not / weren't playing soccer in the park.

questions.prompt: He was cooking dinner when the phone rang. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: he cooking dinner when the phone rang?
he cooking dinner when the phone rang
questions.explanation: Đưa 'Was' lên trước chủ ngữ 'he'.

questions.prompt: He was cooking dinner when the phone rang. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: was not cooking dinner when the phone rang.
was not cooking dinner when the phone rang
wasn't cooking dinner when the phone rang.
wasn't cooking dinner when the phone rang
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau 'was': was not / wasn't cooking dinner...

exercise_groups.group_title: 8. Phân Loại Câu Theo Cách Sử Dụng
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn đúng cách sử dụng của câu: A (Thời điểm nhất định), B (Xảy ra đồng thời), C (Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào):

questions.prompt: 1. At 8 PM last night, I was watching a movie. (Vào lúc 8 giờ tối qua, tôi đang xem một bộ phim.)
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Có mốc giờ cụ thể 'At 8 PM last night' ➔ Ở thời điểm nhất định.

questions.prompt: 2. While she was cooking dinner, he was setting the table. (Trong khi cô ấy đang nấu bữa tối, anh ấy đang dọn bàn.)
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Hai hành động diễn ra song song (có 'while') ➔ Xảy ra đồng thời.

questions.prompt: 3. They were playing soccer at 3 PM yesterday. (Họ đang chơi bóng đá lúc 3 giờ chiều qua.)
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Có mốc giờ rõ ràng 'at 3 PM yesterday' ➔ Ở thời điểm nhất định.

questions.prompt: 4. I was studying for my exam while my friend was playing video games.
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Hai người làm hai việc cùng lúc nối bằng 'while' ➔ Xảy ra đồng thời.

questions.prompt: 5. He was reading a book when the lights went out. (Anh ấy đang đọc sách khi đèn tắt.)
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Đang đọc sách thì hành động đèn tắt ('went out') xen vào ➔ Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào.

questions.prompt: 6. I was working on my project when my computer crashed.
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Đang làm việc thì máy tính sập nguồn xen vào ➔ Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào.

questions.prompt: 7. While they were watching a football match, it started to rain.
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Đang xem bóng đá thì trời đổ mưa cắt ngang ➔ Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào.

questions.prompt: 8. We were chatting on the phone while waiting for the bus.
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Vừa nói chuyện vừa chờ xe buýt song song ➔ Xảy ra đồng thời.

questions.prompt: 9. He was playing the guitar when the power went out.
options: A. Ở thời điểm nhất định
C. Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào
questions.explanation: Đang chơi đàn thì mất điện cắt ngang ➔ Đang xảy ra thì bị xen vào.

exercise_groups.group_title: 9. Nhận Diện Dấu Hiệu Quá Khứ Tiếp Diễn
exercise_groups.instruction: Xác định dấu hiệu thời gian nhận biết thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn trong câu:

questions.prompt: 'At 7 PM last night, I was cooking dinner.' ➔ Dấu hiệu thời gian là:
questions.explanation: Cụm 'At 7 PM last night' là mốc thời gian cụ thể trong quá khứ.

questions.prompt: 'At this time last year, we were traveling to Japan.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
questions.explanation: 'At this time last year' là dấu hiệu điển hình của QKTD.

questions.prompt: 'While they were playing tennis, it started to rain.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
questions.explanation: 'While' diễn tả một hành động đang kéo dài.

questions.prompt: 'I was studying for my exam when my phone rang.' ➔ Dấu hiệu liên từ là:
questions.explanation: 'When' dẫn đầu mệnh đề hành động xen vào (my phone rang).

questions.prompt: 'At noon yesterday, she was having lunch with her colleagues.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
questions.explanation: 'At noon yesterday' là mốc thời gian cụ thể (vào trưa hôm qua).

exercise_groups.group_title: 10. Sắp Xếp Từ Thành Câu Hoàn Chỉnh
exercise_groups.instruction: Sắp xếp các từ cho sẵn thành câu hoàn chỉnh đúng ngữ pháp:

questions.prompt: soccer / park / They / in / were / playing / the.
answers: They were playing soccer in the park.
They were playing soccer in the park
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: S (They) + were + V-ing (playing) + O (soccer) + nơi chốn (in the park).

questions.prompt: a / book / was / reading / when / He / I / called / him.
answers: He was reading a book when I called him.
He was reading a book when I called him
When I called him, he was reading a book.
When I called him, he was reading a book
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: Hành động đang xảy ra (He was reading a book) when hành động xen vào (I called him).

questions.prompt: dinner / We / at / 7 PM / were / having.
answers: We were having dinner at 7 PM.
We were having dinner at 7 PM
At 7 PM, we were having dinner.
At 7 PM we were having dinner
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: We were having dinner at 7 PM.

questions.prompt: while / laughing / watching / were / The / children / a / cartoon.
answers: The children were laughing while watching a cartoon.
The children were laughing while watching a cartoon
questions.explanation: The children were laughing while watching a cartoon.

questions.prompt: studying / for / I / my / exam / was / while / outside / playing / my / friends / were.
answers: I was studying for my exam while my friends were playing outside.
I was studying for my exam while my friends were playing outside
While my friends were playing outside, I was studying for my exam.
While my friends were playing outside, I was studying for my exam
questions.explanation: Hai hành động song song kết nối bằng while: I was studying for my exam while my friends were playing outside.
